text:
Maria P: Kicking off saturn1 bring-up validation. Running the initial checklist now — posting quick commands/results. @Jin @Ravi please monitor and flag anything.

Jin: On it. Capacity target for the initial pool is 8 GPUs across the cluster. Confirming topology (2 racks, 4 GPUs each).

Ravi: Confirmed: 8 A100-ish devices deployed. BGP peering set to saturn-edge-1. Need to validate MTU, multicast, and verify no asymmetric routes.

ops-bot: Deployment job triggered: deploy/saturn1-bootstrap #452. Status: running -> step: provision-nodes.

Maria P: Quick health run results so far. Commands I executed:
```bash
ssh saturn-bastion
for n in node[01..08]; do ssh $n 'nvidia-smi -L && uname -r'; done
```
Output mostly green, some kernel mismatch warnings on node03.

Jin: NVML shows an ECC counter warning on node03 but device passes compute smoke. Scheduling BIOS/firmware reset for node03 during maintenance window (non-prod).

Ravi: Network notes:
- `ip link show` on ToR -> MTU 9000
- `ethtool -S` shows tx_drop on rack-2 interfaces (~0.7% pkts)
- Router team alerted to clear queues and check buffer tuning

ops-bot: Job update: deploy/saturn1-bootstrap #452 -> consul-join completed, etcd quorum 5/5, kubelet bootstrap succeeded on nodes 1-8.

Maria P: Higher-level health quick checks: 
- kube nodes Ready: 8/8
- system pods: all running (kube-system, calico, monitoring)
- NUMA balance check: pass on all nodes
- basic perf sample: `./bin/pinglatency --qps 50` -> p50 12ms, p95 38ms

Jin: Cost FYI: estimated incremental egress + storage sync for saturn1 ~ $7k/mo at projected traffic. Ops and Finance synced on trial budget, but flagging for product budget owners.

Priya (SRE): Proposed gating for handoff:
1) ECC warning on node03 resolved (no ECC errors after firmware reset)
2) No tx-drop events for 2 consecutive hours on all ToRs
3) Perf test p95 < 45ms under a sustained 60 qps workload
If these pass I'll sign off the readiness review.

Maria P: Agreed. Adding one more gate: KV cache persistence test for long sequence lengths (simulate heavy prefix reuse). I'll run an hour-long stability sweep overnight and post artifacts.

Ravi: One more region constraint to note: saturn1 is single-AZ at the moment. Recommend we DO NOT route production-critical traffic (customer-facing) until warm-standby saturn2 is provisioned. We'll allow internal ramping and experiments only.

Jin: @Priya I'll attach the node03 firmware logs and ping when reset completes. ETA ~45m.

Priya (SRE): :thumbsup: I'll watch the metrics and run regression eval on the test set after the reset.

ops-bot: Reminder: handoff-review meeting scheduled tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Invite sent to #eng-infra, #eng-sre, #product.

Maria P: Holding formal handoff until gates above are green. If anyone sees a new blocker post here. Thanks team :rocket:
